title: A numeric kind a 1.0 consumer does not know
description: The kind is one a later MINOR might add (§11.2.2). §5.1.6 folds it onto text for display, and §8.5.2 must not infer a string type from that fold — otherwise every value here is unrankable and the standing vanishes, which is the opposite of what §11.2.1 promises.
